changes: p2 re-segmented as Mallāramiśrātmaja-Lālacandraśarmaṇā, so the name is Lālacandra, not Tājalālachandraśarman; titles reduced to śarman
Added p3 Mallāra (miśra), father of p2, relative_only
Added the relation p2 son_of p3
Scribe role for p2 marked as uncertain in the notes

notes: The author's name is cut short. It is probably Varadabhaṭṭa, i.e. Varadarāja. The patron's name is read as Mallāramiśrātmaja-Lālacandraśarmaṇā: 'tāja' would be a corruption of 'tmaja'. 'likhiteyaṃ lekhāpitā ca' suggests that Lālacandra both wrote and commissioned the copy, but a scribe's name may be lost in the lacuna before it. 'kṛṣṇa' is a maṅgala name and Paśupati a deity, so neither is a person. Phālguna of VS 1774 falls in about February–March 1718 CE.
